name: Reporting Request 7
definition: Provides further details on the reporting request.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the account owner, to unambiguously identify the account reporting request.

RequestedMessageNameIdentification.name: Requested Message Name Identification
RequestedMessageNameIdentification.definition: Specifies the type of the requested reporting message.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account to which the reporting request refers.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

AccountServicer.name: Account Servicer
AccountServicer.definition: Party that manages the account on behalf of the account owner, that is manages the registration and booking of entries on the account, calculates balances on the account and provides information about the account.

ReportingSequence.name: Reporting Sequence
ReportingSequence.definition: Specifies the range of identification sequence numbers which are being requested.

RequestedTransactionType.name: Requested Transaction Type
RequestedTransactionType.definition: Identifies the transactions to be reported.

RequestedBalanceType.name: Requested Balance Type
RequestedBalanceType.definition: Provides details on the requested balance reporting.
